desc:
🏃‍♂️💨 Sprint, level up & become UNSTOPPABLE Ultimate Halloween Speed Runner! 💪🔥
Race through deadly stages, dodge insane hazards, and stack massive multipliers to dominate the leaderboard!
🔥 How to play:
🏃 Run & jump through 10 brutal stages
🌋 Survive lava, crushers, fading platforms & a chasing boss
💤 Train AFK on treadmills while you're away
💰 Stack up multiple bonusses
🔁 Rebirth up to R8 for permanent rewards
💎 Features:
⭐ Powerful upgrades & rebirth system
⭐ Stunning auras and glowing trails
⭐ Roblox Plus gives +50% EXP Boost!
🏆 Climb the leaderboard and become a LEGEND!
